rationale: The porch camera (CAM-S1) is a battery-powered camera reporting 7% battery and status offline, while all other devices are online and the base station uplink/storage are healthy. Firmware is compatible (v3 protocol supported) and RSSI is fine (-62 dBm), so the low battery is the decisive cause of the failed live view.

repair_steps: Instruct customer to remove the porch camera from its mount and bring it indoors.
Guide customer to connect the camera to the provided USB charging cable and a standard USB power adapter.
Advise customer to charge the camera for at least 4-6 hours or until the LED indicator shows solid green (fully charged).
After charging, instruct customer to remount the camera and verify the live view works in the app.
If live view still fails, check the battery percentage in the app; if it remains low, try a different cable/adapter and charge again.
If the camera still does not come online after a full charge, escalate to Tier 2 for possible battery replacement.
output.customer_reply: Thanks for your patience. We found that your porch camera's battery is critically low at 7%, which is why live view isn't working. Please bring the camera inside, charge it with the included USB cable for at least 4-6 hours until the LED is solid green, then remount it. After charging, try live view again. If the issue persists, let us know and we'll assist further.

complaint: The porch camera won't start live view; it just spins and then says camera unavailable. It started a couple of days ago. I thought it was the Wi-Fi because our router was updated recently, so I rebooted the router twice, but nothing changed. The other cameras are fine.
